title: Primary living space on the ground floor has direct access to the primary garden area
text: C2.1.1 The dwelling is to have one room that is the designated primary living space where: i. the primary living space is provided on the ground floor, it is to have direct physical and visual access to the primary garden area; or

replaces.note: no Part B equivalent for single houses R40 and below
Part C text carried into Chapter 2

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Clause carries no density qualifier but tests access to the primary garden area, which exists only at R50-R80 and R100-SL (C1.1.3). Whether it binds R40 and below (where the outdoor living area applies) is unclear; encoded for all codes as printed. Verify scope.

verified.note: Values and wording match p15. Ambiguous on the page: the clause carries no density qualifier but tests access to the primary garden area (a term used at R50+ / R100-SL); whether it binds R40 and below is not stated.
